title: Middle layer Fourier polynomial
statement: For a natural number $m$, form a real polynomial by summing over all subsets $U$ of the $2m$ coordinates: the coefficient of $X^{|U|}$ contributed by $U$ is the Fourier coefficient of the middle layer indicator at $U$.
